problem: The rule is stated wrongly: "in every prefix read so far the operands outnumber the operators by one". For 3 4 2 * + the prefix "3 4" has 2 operands and 0 operators, a difference of 2, not 1, so a correct string would look invalid under this test.
fix: In every prefix read so far the number of operands is at least one more than the number of operators; the difference may be larger than one. Only when the whole string has been read is the difference exactly one (one value left on the stack).
